title: HandLive — sms/sync (C→S, ack with data)
description: SMS-01 API 1. The client loops on page_token until has_more = false, sending the same cursor on every page. The success ack carries a page: #/$defs/ack.

cursor.description: Cursor received at the previous sync; absent on the first sync.

page_token.description: page_token of the previous page's ack; only while looping.

cursor.description: Opaque to the client; Android writes b64u of the JSON {"v":1,"id":…,"t":…}.

page-token.description: Opaque to the client; Android writes b64u of a stateless JSON page position.

ack.description: Success ack of sms/sync. Error acks use ack.schema.json#/$defs/failure (FEATURE_DISABLED, PERMISSION_MISSING, BAD_REQUEST, SMS_CURSOR_INVALID, INTERNAL).

ack-data.description: One page: at most SMS_PAGE_MAX = 500 messages and 180 KiB of plaintext. page_token only while has_more = true; unread only on the last page.

cursor.description: Cursor after the whole sync; the client saves it only when has_more = false.

unread.description: Every conversation with unread messages on the phone; absent conversations are fully read.
